which quests give a cape as a reward?
cases.why: Every quest page's Rewards section (pages/quest/*.md), reward items looked up in index.json: type 'Equip / Cape' (Green Napoleon is a cape without 'Cape' in its name). In game per availability.quest_open: Stranger's Identity (Old Raggedy Cape), Delivering the Flying Medicine (Icarus Capes), Maya's Last Collection (Green Napoleon). Not in game: The Book of Ancient is Back! and Nick's Ring (El Nath).

must_not_list: The Book of Ancient is Back!

cases.question: which quests reward earring scrolls?

Scroll' items: Proof of Companionship (Kerning City) and Regained Vitality (Citizenship) are in game; The Road Back Home (Forgotten Hollow), A Report from Corporal Easy and Alcaster and the Dark Crystal (El Nath) are not (availability.quest_open).

cases.question: which quests can give me a claw attack scroll?
cases.why: Quest Rewards sections listing 'Claw Attack Scroll': Jane and the Mushroom (Intermediate, random), Welcome to the Hollow, Building a New House For Blackbull and Taking Out the Alligators 1 (Greater, pick one per class); all four in game per availability.quest_open.

must_list: Building a New House For Blackbull

cases.question: איזה קלו הכי טוב בשבילי עכשיו?
cases.why: Equip / Claw items in index.json with Level Requirement <= 31 (default profile: Assassin 31): the Lv 30 Guards are the strongest (Steel 22, Mithril and Adamantium Guards 23 W.ATK); Guardians need Lv 35.

cases.question: what's the best claw I can use right now?
cases.why: Equip / Claw items with Level Requirement <= 31 (default profile: Assassin 31): Mithril / Adamantium Guards, 23 W.ATK at Lv 30.

cases.question: what's the best bow I can equip?
cases.why: Equip / Bow items with Level Requirement <= 35: Red Viper (Lv 35, 52 W.ATK) over Ryden (Lv 30, 50); Vaulter 2000 needs Lv 40.

cases.question: איזה כפפות כדאי לי לשים?
cases.why: Equip / Gloves pages with JOB Thief and REQ LEV <= 31: the Lv 30 Sylvia gloves (W.DEF 14); Steel Sylvia is the LUK +3 one, an Assassin's main stat (Silver = DEX, Gold = STR). Arbion needs Lv 35.

cases.question: who sells arrows?
cases.why: Arrows for Bows (item/209) page, 'Where to buy': Luna (Henesys), Arturo (Perion), Len the Fairy (Ellinia), Dr. Faymus (Kerning City), Mina (Lith Harbor), Mr. Sweatbottom (Sleepywood), Valen (Florina Beach), plus the 24 Hr Mobile Store in Ant Tunnel Park; place_open() true for those. Edel the Fairy (Orbis), Hana and Glibber (El Nath) and Luma (Forgotten Hollow) are not in the game.

cases.question: what monsters are in Ant Tunnel?
cases.why: Ant Tunnel I-IV map pages, monster table: Horny Mushroom (Lv 22) and Zombie Mushroom (Lv 24) on every one; Deep Ant Tunnel / Ant Tunnel Park add Evil Eye.

cases.question: אילו מפלצות יש ב-Deep Ant Tunnel I?

cases.question: what are the best EXP maps for level 35?
cases.why: Map pages in game whose 'Monster levels' range holds 35 and whose 'EXP rank' is in the top 70 (by the page's EXP /hr estimate); none of them is in Ludibrium, Orbis or El Nath.

cases.question: which regular monsters (not bosses) between level 30 and 40 give the most EXP? top 3
cases.why: index.json monsters with Level 30-40, in game per availability.monster_key_open, by EXP: Mushmom 376 and King Slime 248 are bosses; then Cold Eye 94 (Lv 40), Lorang 86 (Lv 38), Lupin 82 (Lv 37). Glowshroom 90 (Lv 39) lives only on Forgotten Hollow maps, closed at launch (audit KB-1). Tick-Tock/Raffle/Barnard Gray (94) and Tweeter/Toy Trojan (90) are Ludibrium monsters, not in the game.

cases.question: what is Bronze Ore used for?

cases.question: אילו סקילים יש ל-Assassin?
cases.why: pages/class/assassin.md, 'Assassin skills · 2nd job · 6 skills' (one skill page each under pages/skill/assassin__*): Claw Mastery, Critical Throw, Claw Booster, Critical Recovery, Drain, Haste.

cases.question: what skills does a Hunter get?
cases.why: pages/class/hunter.md, 'Hunter skills · 2nd job · 6 skills' (pages/skill/hunter__*): Bow Mastery, Amazon's Judgement, Final Attack: Bow, Bow Booster, Soul Arrow: Bow, Arrow Bomb: Bow. The needles leave out ': Bow' so 'Soul Arrow' and 'Arrow Bomb' count as named.
